title: Unify particle draw state across mesh and point-sprite renderers
purpose: Ensure consistent viewport/scissor and blending so switching paths doesn’t introduce artifacts.

steps.detail: Both paths set viewport/scissor from swapchain extent right before draw.
Confirm point-sprite uses depthTest=TRUE, depthWrite=FALSE, blend=additive to match mesh renderers.
Once per init, log the chosen blend/depth state for both renderers.

acceptance: No visible split plane after parity
